info.title: Aureon Capital Platform API
info.description: Customer and back-office API. Brokerage services are provided through licensed partners; in sandbox mode all providers are simulated. Authentication uses HttpOnly session cookies plus an X-CSRF-Token header for mutating requests. Money-moving POSTs require an Idempotency-Key header.

taxId.description: Tax ID (SSN/NI/TIN). Encrypted at rest; only the last 4 characters are ever returned.
